title: ClipVault Now
description: ClipVault in 2026. Nine channels serving Verity County, seven of which are not operated by anyone in Verity County.

channels.name: Verity County Daily
channels.about: Daily coverage of Verity County. New videos every four hours. Produced without a camera, a reporter, or anyone who has been to Verity County.

channels.name: The Ledger, Read Aloud
channels.about: Articles from [url=synth://verityledger.com/]verityledger.com[/url] performed by a synthetic voice. Not affiliated with, licensed by, or acknowledged by the Verity Ledger.

channels.name: GRIDFALL SUBSTATION 24/7
channels.about: One drone shot of the former Gridfall substation. Uploaded again every day with a different title. The drone has not moved since 2024.

channels.name: Signal Files
channels.about: Unsolved mysteries of rural America. Narrated. Researched. Neither of those. New episode daily.

channels.name: CountyClips Verity
channels.about: Reuploads of local content from across the region, cropped, sped up 4%, and captioned automatically.

channels.name: Marla Enns
channels.about: I live in Gridfall. I film things that are here. I do not take requests and I do not do sponsorships. My older stuff is on [url=synth://clipvault.tv/]clipvault.tv[/url].

channels.name: Ashkettle Station Project
channels.about: Documenting what is left of the Verity Rail branch line, one mile at a time. Run by two people with a tripod. We post at [url=synth://forums.verityrail.org/]forums.verityrail.org[/url] too.

channels.name: Verity County Transit (Official)
channels.about: Official channel of Verity County Transit. Service updates, rider education, and safety content. Comments are managed by a vendor.

channels.name: Blue Kestrel Eats
channels.about: Small-town diner food, recreated. Partner links in every description. No connection to any diner.

videos.title: the substation fence, september
videos.description:
I walked the fence line at the old substation because a video with two million views said the fire was in 1998 and I wanted to look at the plaque again.

The plaque says 2003. It is bolted to a post about forty feet in from the gate. It is green now.

That is the whole video. Six minutes of walking and then the plaque. No music.

If you want the fire itself, the Ledger's coverage from that week is at [url=synth://verityledger.com/]verityledger.com[/url], and people who were there wrote about it at [url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/]boards.gridfall.net[/url] while it was still burning.

comments.body: Thank you for going out there. My dad was on the truck. He is 78 and he has stopped arguing with the internet about it, which I think is the healthier choice, but I am glad somebody went and filmed the plaque.
The green is copper carbonate. It does that after about twenty years. You can date the plaque by it, roughly.
Your content deserves more views! DM for organic growth packages.
No.

comments.body: Great blue. They nest up past the bend. There were three last year.
This got stolen and put on CountyClips with 500,000 views. I reported it. I do not think reporting does anything but I did it.

videos.title: last day at the Blue Kestrel (2006) - rescanned
videos.description:
I shot this on a camcorder on the last day the Kestrel was open, in November 2006. I put it online once, years ago. The tape is in a drawer.

I rescanned it this week because a true-crime channel made a forty-two minute video claiming the diner and everyone in it disappeared. About thirty of us were there. We had pie. Dale locked the door at two and that was it.

You can see Dale at 4:30. You can see the counter. You can see the sign lit for the last time at 11:52.

Nobody disappeared. He retired. The roof needed twelve thousand dollars.

Original upload is still on [url=synth://clipvault.tv/]clipvault.tv[/url] if you want the 2006 version with the bad audio.

comments.body: That is my aunt at 7:02 in the blue coat. She passed in 2019. I did not know this footage existed. Thank you.
I can send you the raw file if you want it without my titles on it. Message me.
Dale taught my driver's ed. He was terrible at it and very kind.
Fascinating archival footage! Would you be interested in licensing this for an upcoming episode?
No.

videos.title: Mile 14 to Mile 16 - the cut through Halsey ridge
videos.description:
Two miles of the old branch alignment, walked end to end with a tripod every hundred yards.

The cut is still clean. The ballast is mostly there under the leaf litter. We found one date nail, 1951, and left it where it was.

No narration. Birds and our footsteps.

Our survey notes and the mile-by-mile map are posted at [url=synth://forums.verityrail.org/]forums.verityrail.org[/url]. Historical background on the branch closure is at [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/]wiki.gridfall.net[/url] and is, unusually, correct.

comments.body: 1951 date nail is right for the Halsey relay. They did that segment in two seasons.
The sound of this is extraordinary. Twenty-seven minutes of a place nobody goes.

videos.title: What is actually left of Ashkettle station
videos.description:
There is a platform edge, about sixty feet of it, and a concrete pad where the freight house stood. That is all.

We are posting this because four separate channels have now used footage of other stations and called them Ashkettle. One of them has a million views. Ours has fourteen thousand and is the only one filmed at Ashkettle.

The four surviving photographs of the station as built are reproduced at 11:20 with the archive's permission.

comments.body: Saving this. When the next bot documentary comes through I am going to link it instead of arguing.
Great video! The Ashkettle branch continues to serve the community today.
It does not. It closed in 2004. We are standing in it.
